files.quality_label: Noether Paper 31 RA73 German source-header/footnote-counter repair candidate
files.coverage: Paper 31, Der Diskriminantensatz für die Ordnungen eines algebraischen Zahl- oder Funktionenkörpers, Journal für die reine und angewandte Mathematik 157 (1927), pp.82-104. The package contains a German cumulative TeX/PDF/log candidate, RA72-to-RA73 diff, GDZ IIIF source manifest and page/canvas map, raw full-resolution article-span JPG witnesses, labelled 1200dpi inspection crops, fix/disposition/source-crop CSVs, method note, README, and checksums.
files.findings: The source opening has the author line `Von Emmy Noether in Göttingen.` and source footnotes on printed p.82 begin at `1)`. RA73 restores the source author line and inserts `\setcounter{footnote}{0}` immediately before Paper 31. No Paper 31 mathematical body text or prose body text changed. XeLaTeX compiled successfully twice.
files.limitations: Targeted source-apparatus/header repair evidence only. It does not certify every Paper 31 formula or prose line, does not promote a unified German branch, and does not propagate to English, Spanish, Japanese, French, Chinese, Ukrainian, Russian, or Interslavic branches.
